class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-8"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element  vc_custom_1770334493259" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h1>Seasons Kitesurf Sardinia</h1>
<h2>Year-round wind conditions for kitesurfing in South Sardinia</h2>

		</div>
	</div>

	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p><strong>South Sardinia</strong> offers good <strong>wind conditions for kitesurfing</strong> throughout the year. Depending on the <strong>season</strong>, wind strength, wind direction, temperatures and the choice of the best spots can vary. These differences make Sardinia a versatile destination for kitesurfers of all levels.</p>
<p>As we <strong>live year-round in South Sardinia</strong> and are regularly on the water, we have gathered many years of practical experience about the <strong>wind seasons in Sardinia</strong>. On this page you will find a <strong>month-by-month overview</strong> that helps you understand <strong>what is the best period to kitesurf in Sardinia</strong> and quickly identify the <strong>best months</strong> based on the conditions you prefer and your level.</p>
<p>👉 If you would like to know <strong>where to kitesurf in Sardinia</strong> – with an overview of the <strong>kite spots, kite holidays and practical travel information</strong> – you can find our complete guide here: <a href="/kitesurf-sardinia/"><strong>Kitesurf Sardinia</strong></a>.</p>

		</div>
	</div>
<div class="vc_message_box vc_message_box-standard vc_message_box-rounded vc_color-info vc_custom_1769359042834" ><div class="vc_message_box-icon"><i class="fa fa-info-circle"></i></div><p>Our <a href="https://kitehousesardinia.com/kitesurf-punta-trettu/"><img decoding="async" class="emoji" role="img" draggable="false" src="https://s.w.org/images/core/emoji/17.0.2/svg/1f32c.svg" alt="🌬" /></a> <strong><a href="/kitesurf-punta-trettu/">kitesurf school</a></strong> as well as our 🌴 <strong><a href="/holiday-apartments-punta-trettu/">holiday homes</a></strong> are <strong>open all year round</strong>.</p>
</div><div id="ultimate-heading-65876acd06914bdeb" class="uvc-heading ult-adjust-bottom-margin ultimate-heading-65876acd06914bdeb uvc-6450  uvc-heading-default-font-sizes" data-hspacer="no_spacer"  data-halign="left" style="text-align:left"><div class="uvc-heading-spacer no_spacer" style="top"></div><div class="uvc-main-heading ult-responsive"  data-ultimate-target='.uvc-heading.ultimate-heading-65876acd06914bdeb h2'  data-responsive-json-new='{"font-size":"","line-height":""}' ><h2 style="--font-weight:theme;margin-top:20px;margin-bottom:10px;">MARCH &amp; APRIL</h2></div></div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p>With the <strong>spring arrival</strong>, from <strong>March</strong> onwards the weather becomes gradually milder, temperatures rise and <strong>wind conditions</strong> become more consistent. <strong>April</strong> is generally considered the month that officially opens the season, with only a few cloudy days and pleasantly warmer temperatures. <strong>Mistral</strong> and <strong>Scirocco</strong> alternate during this period and, with passing <strong>weather systems</strong>, can occasionally bring stronger, gusty winds. Kitesurfing is possible almost everywhere, and <strong>wave conditions</strong> are still present.</p>

		</div>
	</div>
<div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_inner vc_row-fluid vc_custom_1608747497115"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-4"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><style type="text/css" data-type="the7_shortcodes-inline-css"></style><div class="icon-with-text-shortcode  icon-text-id-9f4bd16388dfc0dc729b34c3ebe20a3a layout-1  vc_custom_1768141441263 " ><span   class="text-icon dt-icon-bg-on dt-icon-hover-off" ><span class="icon-inner"><i class="dt-regular-icon soc-icon fas fa-wind"></i><i class="dt-hover-icon soc-icon fas fa-wind"></i></span></span><p class="dt-text-title"  >Main winds: NW / N / SE / W</p><div class="dt-text-desc">Wind strength: 10–40 kn</div></div></div></div></div><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-4"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><style type="text/css" data-type="the7_shortcodes-inline-css"></style><div class="icon-with-text-shortcode  icon-text-id-27fad5c2eae0eceac2c1274f7547f13d layout-1  vc_custom_1768141419383 " ><span   class="text-icon dt-icon-bg-on dt-icon-hover-off" ><span class="icon-inner"><i class="dt-regular-icon soc-icon fas fa-cloud-sun"></i><i class="dt-hover-icon soc-icon fas fa-cloud-sun"></i></span></span><p class="dt-text-title"  >Day air temperature: 18–25 °C</p><div class="dt-text-desc">Weather: Mostly sunny, rarely cloudy</div></div></div></div></div><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-4"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><style type="text/css" data-type="the7_shortcodes-inline-css"></style><div class="icon-with-text-shortcode  icon-text-id-060d329b4543734268ddb3780aa7c169 layout-1  vc_custom_1768141424277 " ><span   class="text-icon dt-icon-bg-on dt-icon-hover-off" ><span class="icon-inner"><i class="dt-regular-icon soc-icon fas fa-temperature-low"></i><i class="dt-hover-icon soc-icon fas fa-temperature-low"></i></span></span><p class="dt-text-title"  >Water temperature: 15–20 °C</p><div class="dt-text-desc">Wetsuit: 5/4 mm</div></div></div></div></div></div><div id="ultimate-heading-11456acd06914cb02" class="uvc-heading ult-adjust-bottom-margin ultimate-heading-11456acd06914cb02 uvc-6660  uvc-heading-default-font-sizes" data-hspacer="no_spacer"  data-halign="left" style="text-align:left"><div class="uvc-heading-spacer no_spacer" style="top"></div><div class="uvc-main-heading ult-responsive"  data-ultimate-target='.uvc-heading.ultimate-heading-11456acd06914cb02 h2'  data-responsive-json-new='{"font-size":"","line-height":""}' ><h2 style="--font-weight:theme;margin-top:20px;margin-bottom:10px;">MAY &amp; JUNE</h2></div></div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p><strong>May</strong> is usually the month with the highest percentage of <strong>windy days</strong>. The <strong>Mistral</strong> often dominates, bringing plenty of sunshine and pleasant temperatures, and the <strong>thermal wind</strong> starts to work reliably.</p>
<p>With the <strong>summer arrival</strong>, in <strong>June</strong> temperatures continue to rise. Days are often warm to hot, with lots of sunshine and regular <strong>thermal wind</strong>, especially at the well-known thermal spots.</p>

		</div>
	</div>
<div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_inner vc_row-fluid vc_custom_1608747497115"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-4"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><style type="text/css" data-type="the7_shortcodes-inline-css"></style><div class="icon-with-text-shortcode  icon-text-id-24d7d2cd0f8c21ef3fae7b1745f5964c layout-1  vc_custom_1768141184202 " ><span   class="text-icon dt-icon-bg-on dt-icon-hover-off" ><span class="icon-inner"><i class="dt-regular-icon soc-icon fas fa-wind"></i><i class="dt-hover-icon soc-icon fas fa-wind"></i></span></span><p class="dt-text-title"  >Main winds: NW / SE</p><div class="dt-text-desc">Wind strength: 15–30 kn</div></div></div></div></div><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-4"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><style type="text/css" data-type="the7_shortcodes-inline-css"></style><div class="icon-with-text-shortcode  icon-text-id-3ca5b5ff6383d27c32036639cedea03c layout-1  vc_custom_1768141368312 " ><span   class="text-icon dt-icon-bg-on dt-icon-hover-off" ><span class="icon-inner"><i class="dt-regular-icon soc-icon fas fa-sun"></i><i class="dt-hover-icon soc-icon fas fa-sun"></i></span></span><p class="dt-text-title"  >Day air temperature: 25–30 °C</p><div class="dt-text-desc">Weather: Sunny</div></div></div></div></div><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-4"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><style type="text/css" data-type="the7_shortcodes-inline-css"></style><div class="icon-with-text-shortcode  icon-text-id-cf8645bc1731df622ab22bc9836e4eb9 layout-1  vc_custom_1768141387078 " ><span   class="text-icon dt-icon-bg-on dt-icon-hover-off" ><span class="icon-inner"><i class="dt-regular-icon soc-icon fas fa-temperature-high"></i><i class="dt-hover-icon soc-icon fas fa-temperature-high"></i></span></span><p class="dt-text-title"  >Water temperature: 20–25 °C</p><div class="dt-text-desc">Wetsuit: 4/3 mm – 3/2 mm</div></div></div></div></div></div><div id="ultimate-heading-69926acd06914d3b6" class="uvc-heading ult-adjust-bottom-margin ultimate-heading-69926acd06914d3b6 uvc-8675  uvc-heading-default-font-sizes" data-hspacer="no_spacer"  data-halign="left" style="text-align:left"><div class="uvc-heading-spacer no_spacer" style="top"></div><div class="uvc-main-heading ult-responsive"  data-ultimate-target='.uvc-heading.ultimate-heading-69926acd06914d3b6 h2'  data-responsive-json-new='{"font-size":"","line-height":""}' ><h2 style="--font-weight:theme;margin-top:20px;margin-bottom:10px;">JULY &amp; AUGUST</h2></div></div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p>In <strong>July</strong> and <strong>August</strong>, the <strong>thermal wind</strong> works very reliably almost every day in <strong>Punta Trettu</strong> and <strong>Porto Botte</strong>.</p>
<p>On the few days with stable <strong>high-pressure conditions</strong>, it is easy to move to <strong>Capoterra</strong>, where the <strong>southerly wind</strong> often still provides good conditions, so you usually don’t miss a kitesurfing day.</p>

		</div>
	</div>
<div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_inner vc_row-fluid vc_custom_1608747497115"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-4"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><style type="text/css" data-type="the7_shortcodes-inline-css"></style><div class="icon-with-text-shortcode  icon-text-id-0f352ae2a0cdd67bd17cf3f211ac6490 layout-1  vc_custom_1768141350483 " ><span   class="text-icon dt-icon-bg-on dt-icon-hover-off" ><span class="icon-inner"><i class="dt-regular-icon soc-icon fas fa-wind"></i><i class="dt-hover-icon soc-icon fas fa-wind"></i></span></span><p class="dt-text-title"  >Main winds: NW / SE</p><div class="dt-text-desc">Wind strength: 15–25 kn</div></div></div></div></div><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-4"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><style type="text/css" data-type="the7_shortcodes-inline-css"></style><div class="icon-with-text-shortcode  icon-text-id-8d652082ec7b8b37a642416941c35a29 layout-1  vc_custom_1768141357038 " ><span   class="text-icon dt-icon-bg-on dt-icon-hover-off" ><span class="icon-inner"><i class="dt-regular-icon soc-icon fas fa-sun"></i><i class="dt-hover-icon soc-icon fas fa-sun"></i></span></span><p class="dt-text-title"  >Day air temperature: 30–35 °C</p><div class="dt-text-desc">Weather: Sunny</div></div></div></div></div><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-4"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><style type="text/css" data-type="the7_shortcodes-inline-css"></style><div class="icon-with-text-shortcode  icon-text-id-88c7408adced081899485f5ab87bb9d8 layout-1  vc_custom_1768141376253 " ><span   class="text-icon dt-icon-bg-on dt-icon-hover-off" ><span class="icon-inner"><i class="dt-regular-icon soc-icon fas fa-temperature-high"></i><i class="dt-hover-icon soc-icon fas fa-temperature-high"></i></span></span><p class="dt-text-title"  >Water temperature: 25–30 °C</p><div class="dt-text-desc">Wetsuit: Shorty or lycra</div></div></div></div></div></div><div id="ultimate-heading-40976acd06914dc38" class="uvc-heading ult-adjust-bottom-margin ultimate-heading-40976acd06914dc38 uvc-6437  uvc-heading-default-font-sizes" data-hspacer="no_spacer"  data-halign="left" style="text-align:left"><div class="uvc-heading-spacer no_spacer" style="top"></div><div class="uvc-main-heading ult-responsive"  data-ultimate-target='.uvc-heading.ultimate-heading-40976acd06914dc38 h2'  data-responsive-json-new='{"font-size":"","line-height":""}' ><h2 style="--font-weight:theme;margin-top:20px;margin-bottom:10px;">SEPTEMBER &amp; OCTOBER</h2></div></div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p><strong>September</strong> and <strong>October</strong> are still warm and mostly sunny months. The first nice <strong>wave conditions</strong> start to form again, while the <strong>Mistral</strong> alternates with the <strong>Scirocco</strong>.</p>
<p>With the <strong>autumn arrival</strong>, hot days with lighter winds can alternate with days featuring stronger <strong>wind conditions</strong>. Beaches are no longer crowded with swimmers, making it possible to kitesurf again at many spots.</p>
<p>This period is also ideal for combining kitesurfing with other activities such as surfing, SUP, wakeboarding, mountain biking, climbing and horse riding.</p>

		</div>
	</div>
<div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_inner vc_row-fluid vc_custom_1608747497115"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-4"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><style type="text/css" data-type="the7_shortcodes-inline-css"></style><div class="icon-with-text-shortcode  icon-text-id-f90140df06e96151f478cd2affb0c51e layout-1  vc_custom_1768141493363 " ><span   class="text-icon dt-icon-bg-on dt-icon-hover-off" ><span class="icon-inner"><i class="dt-regular-icon soc-icon fas fa-wind"></i><i class="dt-hover-icon soc-icon fas fa-wind"></i></span></span><p class="dt-text-title"  >Main winds: NW / SE / E</p><div class="dt-text-desc">Wind strength: 15–30 kn</div></div></div></div></div><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-4"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><style type="text/css" data-type="the7_shortcodes-inline-css"></style><div class="icon-with-text-shortcode  icon-text-id-682d4537bf89279c485a0a2ab6af0018 layout-1  vc_custom_1768141508358 " ><span   class="text-icon dt-icon-bg-on dt-icon-hover-off" ><span class="icon-inner"><i class="dt-regular-icon soc-icon fas fa-sun"></i><i class="dt-hover-icon soc-icon fas fa-sun"></i></span></span><p class="dt-text-title"  >Day air temperature: 25–30 °C</p><div class="dt-text-desc">Weather: Mostly sunny, rarely cloudy</div></div></div></div></div><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-4"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><style type="text/css" data-type="the7_shortcodes-inline-css"></style><div class="icon-with-text-shortcode  icon-text-id-da2e07f5f27ab7ce501c41ad6becc12f layout-1  vc_custom_1768141518592 " ><span   class="text-icon dt-icon-bg-on dt-icon-hover-off" ><span class="icon-inner"><i class="dt-regular-icon soc-icon fas fa-temperature-high"></i><i class="dt-hover-icon soc-icon fas fa-temperature-high"></i></span></span><p class="dt-text-title"  >Water temperature: 20–25 °C</p><div class="dt-text-desc">Wetsuit: 3/2 mm – 4/3 mm</div></div></div></div></div></div><div id="ultimate-heading-69476acd06914e4a5" class="uvc-heading ult-adjust-bottom-margin ultimate-heading-69476acd06914e4a5 uvc-3177  uvc-heading-default-font-sizes" data-hspacer="no_spacer"  data-halign="left" style="text-align:left"><div class="uvc-heading-spacer no_spacer" style="top"></div><div class="uvc-main-heading ult-responsive"  data-ultimate-target='.uvc-heading.ultimate-heading-69476acd06914e4a5 h2'  data-responsive-json-new='{"font-size":"","line-height":""}' ><h2 style="--font-weight:theme;margin-top:20px;margin-bottom:10px;">NOVEMBER &amp; DECEMBER</h2></div></div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p><strong>November</strong> and <strong>December</strong> usually bring less frequent and less consistent wind. Sunny days with lighter winds can alternate with days featuring very strong, unsettled wind and active conditions.</p>
<p>It is a good period to combine kitesurfing with other outdoor activities, taking advantage of quieter spots and mild winter temperatures.</p>

		</div>
	</div>
<div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_inner vc_row-fluid vc_custom_1608747497115"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-4"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><style type="text/css" data-type="the7_shortcodes-inline-css"></style><div class="icon-with-text-shortcode  icon-text-id-1cd4afba1667eb5d9a2e50e44d39f81e layout-1  vc_custom_1768141531892 " ><span   class="text-icon dt-icon-bg-on dt-icon-hover-off" ><span class="icon-inner"><i class="dt-regular-icon soc-icon fas fa-wind"></i><i class="dt-hover-icon soc-icon fas fa-wind"></i></span></span><p class="dt-text-title"  >Main winds: NW / N / NE / SW</p><div class="dt-text-desc">Wind strength: 20–40 kn</div></div></div></div></div><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-4"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><style type="text/css" data-type="the7_shortcodes-inline-css"></style><div class="icon-with-text-shortcode  icon-text-id-151075e35edc3f855f296270c95da058 layout-1  vc_custom_1768141543783 " ><span   class="text-icon dt-icon-bg-on dt-icon-hover-off" ><span class="icon-inner"><i class="dt-regular-icon soc-icon fas fa-cloud-sun"></i><i class="dt-hover-icon soc-icon fas fa-cloud-sun"></i></span></span><p class="dt-text-title"  >Day air temperature: 15–20 °C</p><div class="dt-text-desc">Weather: Sunny and cloudy days, occasional rain</div></div></div></div></div><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-4"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><style type="text/css" data-type="the7_shortcodes-inline-css"></style><div class="icon-with-text-shortcode  icon-text-id-960947fa02b4c1881a0f6e3efe0dbe45 layout-1  vc_custom_1768141556234 " ><span   class="text-icon dt-icon-bg-on dt-icon-hover-off" ><span class="icon-inner"><i class="dt-regular-icon soc-icon fas fa-temperature-low"></i><i class="dt-hover-icon soc-icon fas fa-temperature-low"></i></span></span><p class="dt-text-title"  >Water temperature: 15–18 °C</p><div class="dt-text-desc">Wetsuit: 5/4 mm</div></div></div></div></div></div><div id="ultimate-heading-65316acd06914ed83" class="uvc-heading ult-adjust-bottom-margin ultimate-heading-65316acd06914ed83 uvc-2538  uvc-heading-default-font-sizes" data-hspacer="no_spacer"  data-halign="left" style="text-align:left"><div class="uvc-heading-spacer no_spacer" style="top"></div><div class="uvc-main-heading ult-responsive"  data-ultimate-target='.uvc-heading.ultimate-heading-65316acd06914ed83 h2'  data-responsive-json-new='{"font-size":"","line-height":""}' ><h2 style="--font-weight:theme;margin-top:20px;margin-bottom:10px;">JANUARY &amp; FEBRUARY</h2></div></div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p><strong>January</strong> and <strong>February</strong> are the core <strong>winter</strong> months, often characterised by <strong>strong winds</strong> that can sweep across the island. Despite this, temperatures generally remain mild, especially on clear days, when the warmth of the southern sun is clearly noticeable.</p>
<p>Local kitesurfers are on the water whenever conditions allow, and <strong>wave riding enthusiasts</strong> can find very powerful and well-shaped waves during this period.</p>

		</div>
	</div>
<div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_inner vc_row-fluid vc_custom_1608747497115"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-4"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><style class="dt-text-title"  >Main winds: N / NW / NE</p><div class="dt-text-desc">Wind strength: 25–50 kn</div></div></div></div></div><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-4"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><style type="text/css" data-type="the7_shortcodes-inline-css"></style><div class="icon-with-text-shortcode class="wpb_wrapper"><style type="text/css" data-type="the7_shortcodes-inline-css"></style><div class="icon-with-text-shortcode  icon-text-id-1cdd16c1f913f6f03f96f878567f5db0 layout-1  vc_custom_1768141600174 " ><span   class="text-icon dt-icon-bg-on dt-icon-hover-off" ><span class="icon-inner"><i class="dt-regular-icon soc-icon fas fa-temperature-low"></i><i class="dt-hover-icon 	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element  vc_custom_1769936072171" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">

			<h4>Kitesurfing in Sardinia – Seasonal Guides</h4>
